About

I design interfaces that feel obvious in hindsight. Over the last three years I've worked across product, marketing, and campaign design — moving from wireframe to shipped screen without losing the thread of what the user actually needs.

What's changed recently is speed. I use AI tools not to replace design thinking, but to compress the distance between an idea and a testable concept — moodboards in minutes with Midjourney, layout drafts through Galileo AI, UX copy passes with ChatGPT — so more of my time goes into judgment, not production.

Education: BA (Hons) Political Science, University of Delhi — plus UI/UX and Graphic Design certificates. Formerly President of my university's Art Club (100+ members) and VP of the Women Dev Cell.
